_about: In-world tasks. Real-life ones are never here — each app writes its own to ~/.linggen/quests/<app>.json. A hosted game costs rewards.json stamina.cost.game when it is paid (论道 when it opens) and pays from the `game` table: a little, every day — the card fight is where 修为 is earned. A story board may be left once the player is stuck (「算了，往下走」, rules/skips.mjs): a skip pays NOTHING of `grant` (no 修为, 灵石, item), writes no grade or mark, and the story goes on; what the story itself needs from a board goes in `gives` (handed over even on a skip), never in `grant`. A board left comes back by itself on a later day, offered with its `replay` line (else one made from its title); won then, it pays in full.

tasks._doc: 本王考考你 (rules/kao.mjs; Hanli 10-19): a light offer on a night 银月 is awake, after 入门; at most `per_night` rounds, each counted as it begins (`kao open`), whatever its end; words from games.json drawguess `met`; a word's first clear pays the small-game 灵石 by its looks, never `grant`. Up to 3 looks a round, ~8.7k tokens each: ≤ 9 looks (~78k) a night.

shouchao._about: 兽潮 (rules/shouchao.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-20: 「兽潮塔防可以作为游戏里才有的一个情节. 比如每天固定时间有兽潮攻击沉鼎观. 在游戏里交代一下就好了」, 「可以, 按这个顺序做」; 守墙关 「可以」): a plot the game alone has, never the book's. `hours`: the window, local [from, to) — 酉时; `grace_min`: a night begun in it still counts this long after. `after`: the scene that opens it (古四's 小周天, the first night he has 灵力). `places`: 沉鼎观's own (00-waimen's map) — joined only there. `cost`: rewards.json stamina.cost key, taken as the night is counted (a hosted game's way: a lost night costs nothing, a board on an empty pool is shut). `pay`: by stars — 修为 on `table` (haunt: the layer scales it, past the 回's mark it turns to 灵石), the small-game 灵石 by `rank` (balance.json boards), `herb` of `herbs` (the 药园's, what the beasts come down for). `tell`: 银月's one telling, on the first night's lead until a night is won. `rise`: past the table's `tide` rows, each night on the last that fits: `difficulty` +1.5% (the kit lays it on the count and the hp both) · `growth` +0.002 · gaps −1% (no closer than ×`gap_min`) a night, and the row's boss swapped for one of his 回, a different one each night where more than one is open — gentle on purpose: the human-like bot (tools/shouqiang's) holds near the table's last row for the first nights, then the wall gives a little more each night.

title.en: The beast tide

tell.zh: 胸口的木牌一烫，银月的声音懒懒的：「酉时了。九鼎的灵脉一到黄昏就往上涨，山里的东西闻着这股灵气，成群往沉鼎观扑。」
tell.en: The token on your chest grows warm, and Yinyue's voice comes, lazy: "The hour of the Rooster. At dusk the Nine Cauldrons' spirit veins swell, and everything in these hills smells it and comes down on Chending in droves."

tell.zh: 「外门弟子守墙。少你一个，师兄们也顶得住——你去，是去长本事的。别丢本王的脸。」
tell.en: "The outer disciples hold the wall. Your seniors would manage without you — you go to grow some skill. Don't shame this king."

title.en: The beast tide · Hold the wall

how.zh: 兽潮下山，小满和银月在墙上自动出手。每守住一波，三张符里挑一张；点一只兽，大家集火它。
how.en: Beasts pour down the road; Xiaoman and Yinyue fight on their own. After each wave pick 1 of 3 talismans; tap a beast to focus it.

done_line.zh: 天黑透了，兽潮退回了山里。
done_line.en: Full dark: the tide has drained back into the hills.

tasks._doc: 兽潮 — a daily routine of about 10–20 minutes (design.md § 兽潮): its board offered in 酉时 at 沉鼎观 after 古四's 小周天; each night the next `tide` row of 守墙关 (levels/shouqiang.json) whose beasts are of his 回 (creatures.json `hui`), then the rise; paid by `shouchao.pay`, never `grant`.
